verdict.rationale: No evidence item says ChatGPT offers an opt-out from model training. The only privacy-adjacent items are a generic mention that 'ChatGPT data controls' apply to Computer Use screenshots and the /memories toggle. Neither states that users can stop their content being used to train models, so both count as adjacent controls and earn no credit.
